about: Italian classics and quick noodle bowls.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until just tender. Save 1 cup of the water, then drain.
Meanwhile, warm the oil and garlic in a large pan over low heat until the garlic is pale gold, about 5 minutes.
Add the pepper flakes, then the spaghetti and a splash of the pasta water. Toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Stir in the parsley. Serve with parmesan.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: Cook the fettuccine in salted boiling water. Save ½ cup of the water, then drain.
Melt the butter in a wide pan. Add the cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the parmesan until smooth. Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Toss in the pasta, loosening with pasta water as needed. Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain.
Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic, breaking it up, about 8 minutes, until no pink remains. Stir in the marinara.
Mix the pasta with the sauce. Spread half in a baking dish, dot with the ricotta, then top with the rest.
Cover with the mozzarella and parmesan. Bake for 25 minutes, until bubbling and browned.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water. Save ½ cup of the water, then drain.
Blend the basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan and salt. With the motor running, pour in the oil.
Toss the pasta with the pesto and a splash of pasta water. Fold in the tomatoes.

recipes.title: Pad Thai
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 10 minutes. Drain.
Stir the fish sauce, tamarind and sugar together.
Heat the oil in a wok. Cook the shrimp or tofu and garlic for 2 minutes. Push to the side.
Scramble the eggs in the empty side, then add the noodles and sauce. Toss for 3 minutes.
Add the sprouts and green onions. Serve topped with peanuts and lime.

recipes.title: Sesame Noodles
ingredients: 2 tbsp sesame paste or peanut butter
steps: Cook the noodles. Rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the soy sauce, sesame paste, vinegar, sesame oil, honey and garlic with 2 tbsp warm water.
Toss the noodles with the sauce. Top with cucumber, green onions and sesame seeds. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Lasagna
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the noodles until just tender. Drain and lay flat.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic until no pink remains. Add the tomatoes, tomato paste and oregano. Simmer for 15 minutes. Season.
Mix the ricotta, egg and half the parmesan.
In a 9×13 dish, layer sauce, noodles, ricotta mix and mozzarella. Repeat twice, ending with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 20 minutes more.
Rest for 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Chicken Lo Mein
ingredients: 8 oz lo mein or egg noodles
steps: Cook the noodles. Drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Stir the soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar together.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes, until no pink remains. Add the garlic, carrot and cabbage; cook 2 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce. Toss for 2 minutes. Finish with the green onions.
